## Contributor checklist

- [ ] I used only synthetic or explicitly approved non-private fixtures.
- [ ] I did not add credentials, signing material, private paths, or meeting data.
- [ ] I added or updated focused tests for behavior changes.
- [ ] I ran the relevant checks from `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
- [ ] I documented any user-visible or release-process change.
